Component.description: Circuit breaker F6 in the controller mains circuit.

Component.description: Earth fault protection for the service outlet.

Symptom.name: Controller not responding
Symptom.description: Robot controller not responding; LED indicators not lit.

Symptom.name: All LEDs are OFF at Controller
Symptom.description: No LEDs at all are lit on the Control Module or the Drive Module.

Symptom.name: No voltage in service outlet
Symptom.description: No voltage is available in the Control Module service outlet.

Symptom.name: Problem jogging the robot
Symptom.description: The system can be started but the joystick on the FlexPendant does not work.

Symptom.name: Oil and grease stains on motors and gearboxes
Symptom.description: The area surrounding the motor or gearbox shows signs of oil leaks.

Symptom.name: Mechanical noise
Symptom.description: A faulty bearing emits scraping, grinding, or clicking noises shortly before failing.

Symptom.name: Manipulator crashes on power down
Symptom.description: When Motors OFF is active the manipulator collapses under its own weight.

Symptom.name: Problem releasing Robot brakes
Symptom.description: The internal robot brakes do not release, no robot movement is possible.

FailureMode.name: Main fuse (Q1) might have tripped
FailureMode.description: The mains fuse Q1 inside the Drive Module has tripped.

FailureMode.name: Circuit breaker F6 is malfunctioning or open
FailureMode.description: Circuit breaker F6 (if used) is malfunctioning or open for any other reason.

FailureMode.name: The system is not supplied with power
FailureMode.description: The system is not supplied with power.

FailureMode.name: Tripped circuit breaker (F5)
FailureMode.description: The circuit breaker F5 has tripped.

FailureMode.name: Tripped earth fault protection (F4)
FailureMode.description: The earth fault protection F4 has tripped.

FailureMode.name: The joystick is malfunctioning
FailureMode.description: The joystick on the FlexPendant is malfunctioning.

FailureMode.name: Leaking seal between gearbox and motor
FailureMode.description: The seal between gearbox and motor is leaking oil.

FailureMode.name: Gearbox overfilled with oil
FailureMode.description: The gearbox is overfilled with oil.

FailureMode.name: Faulty power supply to the brake
FailureMode.description: The power supply to the motor holding brake is faulty.

FailureMode.name: Brake contactor (K44) does not work correctly
FailureMode.description: The brake contactor K44 does not work correctly.

FailureMode.name: Supply voltage 24V BRAKE missing
FailureMode.description: The 24V BRAKE supply voltage is missing.

CorrectiveAction.name: Ensure that the mains fuse (Q1) inside the Drive Module is not tripped
CorrectiveAction.description: Ensure that the mains fuse (Q1) inside the Drive Module is not tripped.
CorrectiveAction.instruction_text: Ensure that the mains fuse (Q1) inside the Drive Module is not tripped. Reset the fuse if tripped.
CorrectiveAction.source_title: ABB IRC5 Robot Controller Trouble Shooting Manual

CorrectiveAction.name: Make sure circuit breaker F6 is closed in position 3
CorrectiveAction.description: Make sure circuit breaker F6 is closed in position 3.
CorrectiveAction.instruction_text: Make sure circuit breaker F6 (if used) is closed in position 3. The circuit breaker F6 is shown in the circuit diagram in the product manual for the controller. Reset circuit breaker F6 to the closed position 3.
CorrectiveAction.source_title: ABB IRC5 Robot Controller Trouble Shooting Manual

CorrectiveAction.name: Make sure the system is supplied with power
CorrectiveAction.description: Make sure the system is supplied with power.
CorrectiveAction.instruction_text: Make sure the system is supplied with power. Use a voltmeter to measure incoming mains voltage. Restore the main power supply.
CorrectiveAction.source_title: ABB IRC5 Robot Controller Trouble Shooting Manual

CorrectiveAction.name: Make sure the circuit breaker in the Control Module has not been tripped
CorrectiveAction.description: Make sure the circuit breaker in the Control Module has not been tripped.
CorrectiveAction.instruction_text: Make sure the circuit breaker in the Control Module has not been tripped. Make sure any equipment connected to the service outlet does not consume too much power. Reset the circuit breaker.
CorrectiveAction.source_title: ABB IRC5 Robot Controller Trouble Shooting Manual

CorrectiveAction.name: Make sure the earth fault protection has not been tripped
CorrectiveAction.description: Make sure the earth fault protection has not been tripped.
CorrectiveAction.instruction_text: Make sure the earth fault protection has not been tripped. Make sure any equipment connected to the service outlet does not conduct current to ground. Reset the earth fault protection.
CorrectiveAction.source_title: ABB IRC5 Robot Controller Trouble Shooting Manual

CorrectiveAction.name: Inspect all seals and gaskets between motor and gearbox
CorrectiveAction.description: Inspect all seals and gaskets between motor and gearbox.
CorrectiveAction.instruction_text: Inspect all seals and gaskets between motor and gearbox. Replace seals and gaskets as specified in the product manual for the robot.
CorrectiveAction.source_title: ABB IRC5 Robot Controller Trouble Shooting Manual

CorrectiveAction.name: Check the gearbox oil level
CorrectiveAction.instruction_text: Check the gearbox oil level. Correct oil level is specified in the product manual for the robot. Adjust the oil level to the specified level.
CorrectiveAction.source_title: ABB IRC5 Robot Controller Trouble Shooting Manual

CorrectiveAction.name: Make sure the bearing has sufficient lubrication
CorrectiveAction.description: Make sure the bearing has sufficient lubrication.
CorrectiveAction.instruction_text: Make sure the bearing has sufficient lubrication, as specified in the product manual for the robot. Clean the bearing and apply fresh lubrication as specified in the product manual.
CorrectiveAction.source_title: ABB IRC5 Robot Controller Trouble Shooting Manual

CorrectiveAction.name: Check the brake power supply to the collapsing motor
CorrectiveAction.description: Check the brake power supply to the collapsing motor.
CorrectiveAction.instruction_text: Check the brake power supply to the collapsing motor during the Motors OFF state. Also see the circuit diagrams in the product manuals for the robot and the controller. Replace the motor as a complete unit if found faulty.
CorrectiveAction.source_title: ABB IRC5 Robot Controller Trouble Shooting Manual

CorrectiveAction.name: Make sure the brake contactor is activated
CorrectiveAction.description: Make sure the brake contactor is activated.
CorrectiveAction.instruction_text: Make sure the brake contactor is activated. A 'tick' should be audible, or you may measure the resistance across the auxiliary contacts on top of the contactor. Replace the brake contactor K44 if it does not activate.
CorrectiveAction.source_title: ABB IRC5 Robot Controller Trouble Shooting Manual

CorrectiveAction.name: Check the Drive Module power supply to make sure 24V BRAKE voltage is OK
CorrectiveAction.description: Check the Drive Module power supply to make sure 24V BRAKE voltage is OK.
CorrectiveAction.instruction_text: Check the Drive Module power supply to make sure 24V BRAKE voltage is OK. Replace the Drive Module power supply if the 24V BRAKE voltage is missing.
CorrectiveAction.source_title: ABB IRC5 Robot Controller Trouble Shooting Manual
